article_title: Birds die in blaze at one of largest foie gras farms in the US
adaptation_summary: Adapted for level A; emphasis on article-specific comprehension, vocabulary in context, and concise written responses.

tasks.prompt: What happened at Hudson Valley Farms on Thursday?
options: A fire destroyed farm buildings and killed an unknown number of birds
The farm opened a new bird sanctuary
Workers released every duck and goose
A storm closed the farm without causing damage
tasks.correct_answer: A fire destroyed farm buildings and killed an unknown number of birds
tasks.explanation_hebrew: האירוע המרכזי הוא שריפה שהרסה מבנים בחווה והרגה מספר לא ידוע של עופות.

tasks.prompt: What positive result did emergency crews report?
options: Every building was saved
The fire cause was confirmed immediately
Hundreds of young birds and hatchlings were rescued, and no people were injured
All birds were moved to another state
tasks.correct_answer: Hundreds of young birds and hatchlings were rescued, and no people were injured
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הצוותים חילצו מאות עופות צעירים ואפרוחים, ולא נפגעו עובדים או אנשי כוחות ההצלה.

tasks.prompt: How many fire departments and first responders were involved?
options: Two departments and 20 responders
37 departments and 200 responders
100 departments and 37 responders
One department and 200 responders
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הדיווח, 37 מחלקות כיבוי ו־200 אנשי הצלה השתתפו במענה לשריפה.

tasks.prompt: What does “engulfed” mean in the sentence saying the blaze engulfed several barns?
options: Cleaned completely
Moved slowly away from
Was reported near
Surrounded and covered by flames
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר זה engulfed פירושו שהלהבות הקיפו וכיסו את האסמים.

tasks.prompt: What did farm manager Marcus Henley suspect might have started the fire?
options: An electrical malfunction
A lightning strike confirmed by investigators
A protest outside the farm
A broken water pipe
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הנלי חשד בתקלה חשמלית, אך הכתבה מדגישה שהסיבה לא אושרה.

tasks.prompt: Why was the fire especially hard to stop inside the barn?
options: The farm had no road access
All firefighters arrived the next day
The building was metal-clad with a wood frame, helping flames spread rapidly
The birds blocked the fire engines
tasks.correct_answer: The building was metal-clad with a wood frame, helping flames spread rapidly
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מבנה מצופה מתכת ובעל שלד עץ הקשה על הכבאים לעצור את התפשטות האש בתוך האסם.

tasks.prompt: Explain in 2–3 sentences what is known and not known about the cause of the fire.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שהסיבה הרשמית לא נמסרה, שמנהל החווה חשד בתקלה חשמלית, ושחשד זה לא אושר.
expected_points: Officials had not provided a confirmed cause for the fire.
The farm manager suspected an electrical malfunction.
The article states that this suspicion had not been confirmed.

tasks.prompt: Give two reasons foie gras production is controversial according to the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להזכיר שהעופות מואכלים בכפייה דרך צינורות ושכך הם מעלים יותר משליש ממשקל גופם בזמן קצר; אפשר גם לציין מחאות ואיסורי מכירה.
expected_points: Birds are force-fed through plastic tubes.
The process makes them gain more than one third of their body weight quickly.
Animal-rights groups have protested the practice, and voters in some cities backed sales bans.

tasks.prompt: Write 3–4 sentences describing Peta's proposed response to the fire and what it shows about the group's concerns.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין את שלט הזיכרון המתוכנן, את הקריאה להעביר עופות ששרדו למקלטים ואת הדגש של הקבוצה על רווחת בעלי חיים.
expected_points: Peta said it would put up a nearby billboard in memory of the birds that died.
The group encouraged the farm to donate surviving birds to local sanctuaries.
These proposals reflect Peta's opposition to foie gras production and concern for the birds' welfare.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the fire, emergency response and wider foie gras debate in 4–5 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את השריפה בחווה, מספר לא ידוע של עופות שמתו, חילוץ מאות עופות, תגובת 37 מחלקות ו־200 אנשי הצלה, והמחלוקת סביב האכלה בכפייה ואיסורי המכירה.
expected_points: A fire engulfed barns at Hudson Valley Farms and killed an unknown number of birds.
Crews rescued hundreds of young birds and no workers or responders were injured.
The response involved 37 fire departments and 200 first responders.
The incident drew attention to criticism of force-feeding in foie gras production and ongoing efforts to ban the product.
